annotations.title: .env checker: duplicate keys, empty values and leaked secrets

description: Check a .env file for duplicate keys, empty values, unquoted values with spaces, invalid names and values that look like leaked credentials. Reports each problem with its line number. Choose this before a deploy, or when auditing an environment file, to find duplicate keys, empty values, unquoted values with spaces, invalid names and values whose shape looks like a credential. Do not choose this for a secrets manager or vault, which it cannot read, and do not treat a clean report as proof that no secret is present: the detector is a shape heuristic. Example requests: Check my .env for duplicate keys before I deploy. | Did I leave an empty value or a leaked secret in this environment file? | Audit this dotenv file for mistakes.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

content.description: The customer's input.env, as text. Supported: Plain text KEY=VALUE. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

inputs.title: .env checker: duplicate keys, empty values and leaked secrets

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_env_file_check

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.
